name: Luminous Span
promptTemplate: Suspension bridge at night with {{cable_count}} LED cables displaying {{pattern}} in {{palette}} at {{speed}}x speed, with water ripple {{water_ripple}}, city glow {{city_glow}}, traffic density {{traffic_density}}, river fog {{fog_density}}, and audio reactivity {{audio_surge}}.

pattern.hint: Select the vertical lighting animation routine

cable_count.hint: Number of vertical LED strands along the deck

speed.hint: Cycle rate of descending light ripples

water_ripple.hint: Distortion of mirror reflection on the river

traffic_density.hint: Headlight streaks traversing the lower deck

city_glow.hint: Illumination of skyline towers across the water

audio_surge.hint: Bass pulses send light waves across the span

listing.blurb: A suspension bridge glows in the night as animated LED patterns ripple down its vertical cables and reflect across the river surface.
listing.prompt: A suspension bridge at night whose hundreds of vertical cables are strips of white LEDs: slow generative sequences ripple along them -- falling rain, passing shadows, breathing tides -- mirrored and blurred in the river beneath, city lights far behind. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
